summary: A notice that the socket supporting the TIP News facility at BBN-TENEX moved to socket 367 octal. TIP users were not affected, but because some Telnet programs had a news command, the old socket would remain until April 15, 1973 to give implementers time to switch.

plainLanguage.summary: The TIP News facility at BBN-TENEX moved to a new socket number. The old socket would remain available for a time to help affected TELNET programs switch.

subtitle: A notice that the TIP News facility moved to a new socket.

tldr.problem: The socket supporting the TIP News facility at BBN-TENEX was changed.
tldr.mechanism: The facility moved to socket 367 octal; the TIP program had already been changed to use it.
tldr.outcome: The old socket was to remain available until April 15, 1973, for TELNET programs using the news command.

today: The unit metadata lists RFC 470's status as Unknown. The RFC is an operational notice about the TIP News facility.

sections.title: The New TIP News Socket
sections.content: RFC 470 announces that the socket supporting the TIP News facility at BBN-TENEX changed to socket 367 octal. The notice says TIP users should not be affected because the TIP program had already been changed to use the new socket.
sections.plainLanguage: The TIP News facility moved to socket 367 octal. The TIP program had already been updated, so its users should not notice the change.

sections.title: Keeping the Old Socket Temporarily
sections.content: Some user TELNET programs had implemented a news command that used the old socket. To give their implementers time to change those programs, the old socket was to be maintained until April 15, 1973.
sections.plainLanguage: Programs that still used the old socket had until April 15, 1973, to change. The notice does not state the old socket number.

sections.title: A Socket Change Notice
sections.content: The RFC communicates a change to the TIP News facility's socket and a transition period for user TELNET programs. It does not describe a change to the TIP News content or service behavior.
sections.plainLanguage: This notice is about where programs connect to TIP News. It gives a date for maintaining the old connection point.
